'''Imperial Fleet Command''' was the primary leadership of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], overseeing the operations of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3643 BBY]], Flight Commander [[Pirul]] of Fleet Command recruited a handful of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Imperial, and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] for the newly formed [[Empire's Fury]] squadron.<ref>{{TORcite|type=other|Conversation with Flight Commander Pirul on the Imperial players' ships}}</ref>

Around [[3641 BBY]], [[Omana Tragg]], representative of the [[Isen IV]] mining colony, offered to discuss terms of surrender with Fleet Command, noting several of their victories in the sector.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Hidden Throne|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
